title: Parent stem cells can serve as niches for their daughter cells
finding: Approximately 79% ciliated-cell depletion did not accelerate replacement; basal and secretory populations persisted.
limitation: Large-airway homeostasis experiment, not human immune killing or a validated tolerability threshold.

title: Non-lytic clearance of influenza B virus from infected cells preserves epithelial barrier function
finding: Depletion of infection-surviving, predominantly ciliated-like cells worsened epithelial permeability and recovery.
limitation: Mixed survivor population in an infected lung; not selective depletion of healthy mature ciliated cells.

title: Conditional Depletion of Airway Progenitor Cells Induces Peribronchiolar Fibrosis
finding: Sustained club-compartment depletion caused persistent peribronchiolar fibrosis despite later epithelial regeneration.
limitation: Promoter-defined compartment and toxin exposure do not quantify human receptor-specific risk.

title: Evidence for lung barrier regeneration by differentiation prior to binucleated and stem cell division
finding: AT2 differentiation rapidly compensated AT1 loss; repeated injury produced abnormal epithelial hyperplasia.
limitation: Intact repair under finite experimental insults is not proof of tolerance to persistent T-cell attack.

title: Targeted Type 2 Alveolar Cell Depletion: A Dynamic Functional Model for Lung Injury Repair
finding: AT2 depletion produced recovery, fibrosis or lethal edema depending on severity and kinetics.
limitation: Drug toxicity and model kinetics prevent transfer of depletion percentages to clinical thresholds.

title: Alveolar epithelial cell chemokine expression triggered by antigen-specific cytolytic CD8+ T cell recognition
finding: Alveolar antigen recognition initiated inflammatory recruitment and progressive lethal lung injury.
limitation: Transgenic antigen and transferred T cells; not a human engineered-TCR clinical risk estimate.

title: Two cases of severe pulmonary toxicity from highly active mesothelin-directed CAR T cells
finding: Two severe pulmonary toxicities, one fatal, implicated benign pneumocyte expression in injured lung.
limitation: AT1 versus AT2 initiation was not resolved; product, dose and pre-existing injury matter.

title: Lung function from school age to adulthood in primary ciliary dyskinesia
finding: Lung function declined on average in 486 patients, with heterogeneous trajectories despite treatment.
limitation: Inherited ciliary dysfunction is not epithelial ablation or an immune-toxicity model.

title: Muc5b is required for airway defence
finding: Muc5b deficiency impaired clearance and host defence, unlike Muc5ac deficiency.
limitation: Mucin deletion is not goblet-cell killing; multiple secretory populations produce MUC5B.

title: Dedifferentiation of committed epithelial cells into stem cells in vivo
finding: Secretory cells restored basal stem cells after basal-cell depletion.
limitation: Alternative repair depends on surviving populations and does not establish tolerance to repeated recognition.

title: JAK-STAT activation contributes to cytotoxic T cell-mediated basal cell death in human chronic lung allograft dysfunction
finding: Basal-cell MHC-I induction and cytotoxic T-cell killing were linked to airway-centered allograft injury.
limitation: Alloreactivity affects multiple compartments and is not an isolated engineered-receptor trial.

title: Evidence for cardiomyocyte renewal in humans
finding: Carbon dating demonstrated limited adult cardiomyocyte renewal.
limitation: Renewal is nonzero; a turnover estimate does not measure replacement during acute destructive injury.

title: Cardiovascular toxicity and titin cross-reactivity of affinity-enhanced T cells in myeloma and melanoma
finding: Titin cross-recognition by an engineered TCR caused fatal cardiac toxicity.
limitation: Receptor-specific cross-reactivity; not evidence that every MAGEA3-directed receptor recognizes heart.

title: Cancer regression and neurologic toxicity following anti-MAGE-A3 TCR gene therapy
finding: Severe neurological injury was associated with a cross-reactive TCR and neural MAGEA12 expression.
limitation: Peptide and receptor specificity matter; rare RNA detection alone does not reproduce this evidence.

title: Podocyte depletion causes glomerulosclerosis
finding: Increasing podocyte depletion caused persistent proteinuria, sclerosis and renal dysfunction.
limitation: Model depletion thresholds are not human safety cutoffs.

title: Targeted proximal tubule injury triggers interstitial fibrosis and glomerulosclerosis
finding: Repeated tubular injury caused chronic atrophy, fibrosis and secondary glomerular injury.
limitation: Cre distribution and toxin sensitivity qualify compartment specificity; not clinical immune targeting.

title: Cholangiocytes act as facultative liver stem cells during impaired hepatocyte regeneration
finding: Biliary cells contributed hepatocytes when hepatocyte proliferation was impaired.
limitation: Compensatory plasticity does not establish tolerance of combined biliary and hepatocyte destruction.

title: T cells targeting carcinoembryonic antigen can mediate regression of metastatic colorectal cancer but induce severe transient colitis
finding: CEA-directed TCR treatment caused severe transient colitis in all three treated patients.
limitation: Recovery in a small product-specific trial does not establish general controllability of persistent mucosal targeting.

title: A reserve stem cell population in small intestine renders Lgr5-positive cells dispensable
finding: Alternative progenitors maintained intestinal epithelium during Lgr5-cell depletion.
limitation: An Lgr5-specific insult is narrower than destroying all crypt regenerative populations.

title: Tisagenlecleucel in Children and Young Adults with B-Cell Lymphoblastic Leukemia
finding: Responders developed B-cell aplasia; immunoglobulin replacement was commonly used.
limitation: Manageability requires support; this does not generalize to all lymphocytes or marrow progenitors.

title: Immune targeting of fibroblast activation protein triggers recognition of multipotent bone marrow stromal cells and cachexia
finding: FAP-reactive T cells recognized marrow stromal cells and caused severe systemic toxicity.
limitation: Target distribution and receptor properties matter; not all fibroblasts or all FAP products have equivalent effects.

title: Depletion of stromal cells expressing fibroblast activation protein-alpha from skeletal muscle and bone marrow results in cachexia and anemia
finding: Distributed FAP-positive stromal depletion disrupted muscle and hematopoietic support.
limitation: Distributed target-defined cells differ from a localized dermal fibroblast population.

title: Targeting Fibroblast Activation Protein in Tumor Stroma with Chimeric Antigen Receptor T Cells Can Inhibit Tumor Growth and Augment Host Immunity Without Severe Toxicity
finding: A different FAP CAR achieved antitumor effects without the severe toxicity of other models.
limitation: Counterevidence emphasizes receptor/epitope and target-density dependence, not universal stromal safety.

title: Pax7-expressing satellite cells are indispensable for adult skeletal muscle regeneration
finding: Satellite-cell depletion prevented normal muscle regeneration after injury.
limitation: Localized experimental depletion does not estimate human systemic immune toxicity.

title: Satellite cells, connective tissue fibroblasts and their interactions are crucial for muscle regeneration
finding: Fibroblast depletion altered satellite-cell dynamics and impaired regenerated myofibers.
limitation: Niche-specific dependence cannot be generalized to all fibroblast populations.

title: Collateral Damage: Insulin-Dependent Diabetes Induced With Checkpoint Inhibitors
finding: Checkpoint treatment was associated with insulin deficiency and frequent ketoacidosis at presentation.
limitation: Checkpoint autoimmunity is not selective engineered-TCR beta-cell killing; insulin replacement is ongoing support.

title: Immune-Related Thyroiditis with Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors
finding: Destructive thyroiditis often progressed to hypothyroidism requiring hormone replacement.
limitation: Controlling hormone deficiency does not establish control of acute inflammatory injury.

title: Immune checkpoint inhibitor related hypophysitis: diagnostic criteria and recovery patterns
finding: Pituitary hormone deficits showed limited recovery, particularly the adrenal axis.
limitation: Anatomical swelling, affected axes and hormone support distinguish patients; not a cell-specific ablation trial.

title: Limbal Stem-Cell Therapy and Long-Term Corneal Regeneration
finding: Limbal-cell grafts restored corneal epithelial maintenance after destructive injury.
limitation: Successful transplantation does not make spontaneous limbal recovery reliable or treat retinal injury.

title: Hair Cell Replacement in Adult Mouse Utricles after Targeted Ablation of Hair Cells with Diphtheria Toxin
finding: Adult vestibular hair-cell loss was followed by limited replacement.
limitation: Utricular findings do not establish restoration of human cochlear hearing.

title: Hedgehog/Wnt feedback supports regenerative proliferation of epithelial stem cells in bladder
finding: Urothelial and stromal signaling supported epithelial regeneration after injury.
limitation: Repair after finite injury is not evidence that continuous urothelial killing is tolerable.

title: Dynamics of fat cell turnover in humans
finding: Adult adipocytes turn over while population size is regulated.
limitation: Turnover does not establish the metabolic tolerability of generalized adipocyte destruction.

title: Gene therapy with human and mouse T-cell receptors mediates cancer regression and targets normal tissues expressing cognate antigen
finding: Melanocyte-antigen TCR therapy injured skin, eye and ear compartments.
limitation: Cutaneous depigmentation cannot justify ocular or cochlear melanocyte depletion.

title: Sicca Syndrome Associated with Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor Therapy
finding: Checkpoint-associated sicca included persistent salivary hypofunction.
limitation: Symptom improvement did not guarantee restoration of secretion; not selective receptor targeting.

title: Long-term risks after splenectomy among 8149 cancer-free American veterans
finding: Splenectomy was associated with lasting infection and thromboembolic risks.
limitation: Observational organ-removal evidence is not systemic immune-cell depletion.

title: Health Consequences of Thymus Removal in Adults
finding: Adult thymectomy was associated with adverse long-term health outcomes.
limitation: Observational association, potential confounding and adult context limit causal inference.

title: Radiocarbon dating reveals minimal collagen turnover in both healthy and osteoarthritic human cartilage
finding: Adult articular collagen showed very limited turnover.
limitation: Matrix turnover is not chondrocyte turnover or a direct immune-injury experiment.

title: Immune checkpoint inhibitor-induced inflammatory arthritis persists after immunotherapy cessation
finding: Inflammatory arthritis could persist after checkpoint treatment stopped.
limitation: Mixed joint tissues; not selective cartilage-cell ablation.

title: Making a decision about recurrent tonsillitis in children and adults
finding: Tonsil removal is an established treatment with recognized procedural risks.
limitation: Local removal is not systemic lymphocyte depletion.

title: Appendicitis
finding: Appendectomy permits survival without the appendix.
limitation: Removal does not establish tolerance of in-situ perforation or shared intestinal targeting.

title: Treatment for Gallstones
finding: Cholecystectomy is an established treatment for symptomatic gallstones.
limitation: Does not justify bile-duct or liver targeting, or uncontrolled in-situ inflammation.

title: Definition and Facts of Adrenal Insufficiency and Addison's Disease
finding: Adrenal insufficiency can cause crisis and requires hormone replacement.
limitation: Replacement availability does not establish acute-injury control.

title: Sentinel Lymph Node Biopsy
finding: Regional nodal surgery can cause lymphatic morbidity.
limitation: Regional excision is narrower than distributed lymphatic injury.

title: SITC clinical practice guideline on immune checkpoint inhibitor-related adverse events
finding: Immune injuries span organ-specific acute and persistent consequences.
limitation: Checkpoint-toxicity management cannot validate engineered-cell killing for an untested compartment.

title: Human Protein Atlas tissue and cell-type definitions
finding: Defines tissue and cell annotations used for expression mapping.
limitation: Anatomy supports identity, not tolerability or receptor recognition.

title: Anatomy and Physiology: Female Reproductive System
finding: Defines female reproductive organs and physiological functions.
limitation: Reproductive membership is independent of clinical hazard.

title: Anatomy and Physiology: Male Reproductive System
finding: Defines male reproductive organs and physiological functions.
limitation: Reproductive membership is independent of clinical hazard.

title: CDK4/6 inhibition mitigates stem cell damage in a novel model for taxane-induced alopecia
finding: Hair-follicle stem-cell injury was investigated in an experimental chemotherapy model.
limitation: Chemotherapy injury is not immune ablation; permanent alopecia remains possible.

title: A single cell atlas of human cornea that defines its development, limbal progenitor cells and their interactions with the immune cells
finding: Distinguishes corneal and limbal cell populations.
limitation: Cell identity and expression alone do not measure toxicity.

title: Humoral immune reconstitution after anti-BCMA CAR T-cell therapy in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma
finding: Normal marrow plasma-cell aplasia and prolonged hypogammaglobulinemia followed BCMA-directed CAR T-cell therapy.
limitation: Myeloma, prior therapies and conditioning affect immune recovery; this is not an isolated healthy-plasma-cell ablation trial.
